skill.summary: Run local ComfyUI workflows via the HTTP API. Use when the user asks to run ComfyUI, execute a workflow by file path/name, or supply raw API-format JSON; sup...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ComfyUI skill for running local ComfyUI workflows via the HTTP API.
- Supports generating images by executing workflows from file paths, workflow names, or raw API-format JSON (including default workflow).
- Allows editing workflow JSON before execution: intelligently sets prompt, style, and seed fields based on user input.
- Handles user requests to download model weight URLs into appropriate ComfyUI model folders.
- Automatically installs missing dependencies (e.g., ComfyUI, pget) as needed.
- Always returns generated images directly to the user after a successful run.
